ui.pure_spellbook_and_things.weapon_inte: Adds final Attack Damage and weapon enchant bonuses to all spells
ui.pure_spellbook_and_things.soul_shavin: Every hit shaves 1% Max HP (1-40) via SetHealth
ui.pure_spellbook_and_things.healing_att: Melee: +3 Mana, Spell: +1 HP per hit
ui.pure_spellbook_and_things.overload_ov: Resets all cooldowns & restores Max Mana, grants Overload
ui.pure_spellbook_and_things.akashic_acc: Opens a 4-page (6x3) storage for most scrolls
spell.pure_spellbook_and_things.empowere: Grants +40% Spell Power, +85% Attack Damage, and uninterruptible casting.
spell.pure_spellbook_and_things.weapon_i: Adds your final Attack Damage (including base stat buffs and weapon enchantment bonuses) to all spell damage dealt.
spell.pure_spellbook_and_things.soul_sha: Every attack hit pierces and directly shaves 1% of the target's Max HP (min 1, max 40), even during invulnerability frames.
spell.pure_spellbook_and_things.healing_: Melee hits restore 3 Mana; spell hits restore 1 HP.
spell.pure_spellbook_and_things.overload: Instantly resets all spell cooldowns and restores Mana to full, inflicting Overload (-10% Max Mana per level).
spell.pure_spellbook_and_things.vitality: Restores Hunger, Saturation, and HP while cleansing harmful effects. Scales with Spell Power.
spell.pure_spellbook_and_things.sustaine: Grants Purification for 15 seconds, continuously removing and blocking debuffs.
spell.pure_spellbook_and_things.overheel: Fully heals HP and grants OverHP, which automatically restores missing health until depleted.
spell.pure_spellbook_and_things.evasive_: Teleports 10 blocks forward and grants 1 hit of Evasion for 5 seconds.
spell.pure_spellbook_and_things.akashic_: Opens the ender-chest-style Akashic Record (4 pages of 6x3 slots). Most scrolls can be stored, excluding Akashic Record, Recast, and Continuous-channel spells.
Simultaneously invokes all scrolls stored on Page 1 of the Akashic Record with combined mana, cast time, and cooldown.
Simultaneously invokes all scrolls stored on Page 2 of the Akashic Record with combined mana, cast time, and cooldown.
Simultaneously invokes all scrolls stored on Page 3 of the Akashic Record with combined mana, cast time, and cooldown.
Simultaneously invokes all scrolls stored on Page 4 of the Akashic Record with combined mana, cast time, and cooldown.
spell.pure_spellbook_and_things.extensio: Extends the duration of all active beneficial effects without changing their amplifier. Scales with Spell Power and spell level.
spell.pure_spellbook_and_things.legacy_e: Legacy of the past: Echo Strike
Recreates Echoing Strikes from ISS 3.4.0.4 using Pure Spell Power. Melee and arrow hits unleash delayed AoE echoes.
spell.pure_spellbook_and_things.legacy_o: Recreates Oakskin from ISS 3.4.0.4 using Pure Spell Power. Grants percentage damage reduction without slowing movement.
spell.pure_spellbook_and_things.legacy_h: Recreates Haste from ISS 3.4.0.4 using Pure Spell Power. Boosts movement speed, attack speed, mana regen, and cast time reduction for up to 5 allies in a 3-block radius.
